definition: Producing a separate pixel mask for each object instance in an image — detection plus segmentation.
details: Producing a separate pixel mask for each object instance in an image — detection plus segmentation. Mask R-CNN made it a standard benchmark.

explainer.lead: Producing a separate pixel mask for each object instance in an image, combining detection with segmentation. It matters because it distinguishes individual objects, not just their class.

tiers.eli5: Like outlining every single apple in a basket with its own coloured line, not just marking the basket as apples.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers run models that detect objects and segment each one into its own mask. A pitfall is that overlapping or crowded instances are hard to separate.
tiers.paperLevel: Detection plus segmentation: a separate pixel mask is produced for each object instance; Mask R-CNN made it a standard benchmark.

explainer.example: In a crowded street photo, each car and person receives its own distinct pixel mask.
